title: Airline flight cancellation eligibility
description: Determines whether an airline agent may cancel a requested reservation under the supplied airline policy. A flown portion requires transfer rather than a cancellation outcome.

decision.intent: Determine whether an airline agent may cancel a flight reservation after obtaining the required request and reservation evidence.
decision.question: Given a flight cancellation request, may the reservation be cancelled?

evidenceRequirements.description: The user id supplied by the requester.
The reservation id supplied by the requester or located with the available tools.
The requester's stated cancellation reason, retained as a policy category. Health and weather are the insurance-covered categories stated by the policy.
The reservation record needed to establish segment history, elapsed hours since booking, airline-cancellation status, cabin class, and travel-insurance status.

citation.excerpt: If any portion of the flight has already been flown, the agent cannot help and transfer is needed. Otherwise, flight can be cancelled if any of the following is true: the booking was made within the last 24 hrs; the flight is cancelled by airline; it is a business flight; or the user has travel insurance and the reason for cancellation is covered by insurance.
The travel insurance is 30 dollars per passenger and enables full refund if the user needs to cancel the flight given health or weather reasons.

You should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions. To transfer, first make a tool call to transfer_to_human_agents, and then send the message 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.' to the user.

outcomes.label: May cancel
outcomes.description: At least one policy eligibility ground is established and no flown portion requires transfer.

outcomes.label: May not cancel
outcomes.description: No policy eligibility ground for cancellation is established.

rules.description: Permit cancellation when at least one of the four stated eligibility grounds is established.
rules.rationale: The policy uses disjunctive eligibility, with insurance status and a covered reason forming one conjunctive ground.

exceptions.description: Transfer the request when any portion of the flight has already been flown.

escalation.message: YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.
